title: console settings page: row chips draw English literals in every language — the env-lock chip "Locked by env" (family after objectui#12694)
body:
Filing gate ①: a user-visible localization defect. **reach:** a public entry, Settings → Localization on a zh-CN session whose `OS_LOCALIZATION_DEFAULT_COUNTRY` is set, measured in Chromium against a live backend. **Family:** a settings row's chip draws English source literals, whatever the session language. objectui#12694 (the source badges' "Overrides" / "Inherited from", PR #12819) is its first occurrence. This is the second, so this card covers every chip on the console settings page, with an enumeration pin.

**Reader who acts:** objectui triage. The landing is `apps/console/src/pages/settings/` (`EnvLockBadge.tsx`, and `SettingsField.tsx`'s field header). Filed by `domain:ui` seat 3 (`session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`) from the os-dev report on objectui#12694 (PR #12819), which does not change this. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What happens
- An administrator on a zh-CN session opens Settings → Localization. A setting pinned by an environment variable shows its lock chip in English: "Locked by env".
- Everything else on the row reads in zh-CN.

## Measured
- Backend: objectstack `66d456d01` `examples/app-crm` with `OS_LOCALIZATION_DEFAULT_COUNTRY=CN`. Chromium, console under Vite on PR #12819's branch (which does not touch the chip), `html lang="zh-CN"`.
- The lock chip and its tooltip read `[["Locked by env","Set via env: OS_LOCALIZATION_DEFAULT_COUNTRY"]]`.

## Mechanism (read from source, objectui `main` `5483297`)
- `apps/console/src/pages/settings/EnvLockBadge.tsx:22` draws the chip text `Locked by env` as a JSX literal.
- `:19` falls back to the literal title `'Pinned by environment variable — cannot be edited from the UI.'` when the server sends no `reason`.
- `SettingsField.tsx:166` draws a `Deprecated` chip (with a `→ replacedBy` arrow) as a literal. No platform settings manifest declares a deprecated specifier today, so nothing draws it (zero producers). It is the same class on the same page, so it is in this family's enumeration.
- The page's other copy goes through `console.settingsView.*` in `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (ten bundles); objectui#12694 adds its two badge keys there.
- Out of this card: the tooltip's `Set via env: NAME` is the server's `lockedReason` (objectstack's settings service), a separate seam.

## Expected
- Every chip on a settings row reads in the session's language: the env-lock chip and its fallback title, and the `Deprecated` chip, each from a `console.settingsView.*` key with real translations in all ten bundles. The English output reads exactly as today.
- An enumeration pin over the settings page's components (`apps/console/src/pages/settings/*.tsx`) asserts that no JSX text node or `title` / `aria-label` attribute is a bare English literal. The next chip added cannot ship English-only silently.

**Dedupe** (open and closed):
- every objectui `domain:ui` card (2433 rows, through #12743) plus the 46 newest objectui issues (#12721–#12816), grepped for `Locked by env|EnvLockBadge|env.?lock` (0 hits) and for `settings` near `English|literal|hard-coded` (hits: objectui#12694, the first occurrence; #12671, the `info_banner` row's manifest English, landed; #11801 and #11765, other subjects);
- positive control on the same rows: objectui#12694 and #12810 are found.

Dedupe words: settings env lock chip English, Locked by env, EnvLockBadge, settings Deprecated chip literal, zh-CN settings chip English.
